countOfCustomers: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customerCount FROM customers
customerAndOrdersInnerJoin: select * from customers c inner join orders d on c.customer_id=d.customer_id
orderForSpecificCustomer: select * from customers c inner join orders d on c.customer_id=d.customer_id where c.customer_id=?
sumOfTotalAmount: select sum(order_amount) as totalAmount from customers c inner join orders d on c.customer_id=d.customer_id where c.customer_id=?
paidOrders: select * from customers c inner join orders d on c.customer_id=d.customer_id where d.order_status=?
